name: PixelFlow Volume Rendering
definition: A variant of the polygon resampling approach designed for the PixelFlow graphics system. It overcomes RealityEngine limitations on realistic lighting and data size by allowing pixel processors to manipulate texture values directly.
summary: PixelFlow Volume Rendering is a polygon resampling method that enables general image-space lighting by computing on-the-fly Phong shading from interpolated volume gradients.
